class.name: Recycler
class.brief_description: Internal holder of the view cache, recycled pool and scrap.
class.description: Recycler is an internal port of [i]RecyclerView.Recycler[/i]. It obtains ViewHolders for positions — checking the changed scrap, then the position-bound view cache, then the per-type recycled pool, then the adapter — and recycles them back. The RecyclerView owns one instance ([method RecyclerView.get_recycler]); you only need it to tune cache / pool capacities for unusual workloads.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the cache, scrap and pool.

method.name: flush_scrap_to_pool
method.description: Moves the scrapped holders to the cache / pool at the end of a layout cycle.

method.name: get_cached_view_count
method.description: Returns how many holders are in the view cache.

method.name: get_changed_scrap_count
method.description: Returns how many holders are in the changed scrap.

method.name: get_recycled_view_count
method.description: Returns how many holders of a view type are pooled.

method.name: get_view_for_position
method.description: Returns the [b]ViewHolder[/b] for a position, reusing from cache / pool or creating one.

method.name: prefetch_view
method.description: Pre-creates an unbound holder for a position into the pool (prefetch).

method.name: recycle_view
method.description: Returns a holder to the cache or pool.

method.name: scrap_view
method.description: Keeps a holder removed by an update in the changed scrap for the layout cycle.

method.name: set_adapter
method.description: Sets the adapter the recycler pulls data from.

method.name: set_view_cache_size
method.description: Sets the size of the position-bound view cache (default 1).

method.name: set_view_pool_size
method.description: Sets the per-type recycled pool capacity (default 20, about a screen of items).

method.name: size
method.description: Returns the total number of holders held (cache + pool + scrap).
